div.head: Ine 29
div.ab: LXXIII. Gif mon sweordes onlæne oþres ésne, ⁊ he losige, gilde he hine ðriddan dæle; gif mon spere sylle, healfne (dæl) hine gilde; gif mon horses læne, ealne he hine gilde.
LXXIII. Gif mon sweordes onlæne oðres esne, ⁊ he losie, gielde he hine ðriddan dæle; gif mon spere selle, healfne; gif he horses onlæne, ealne he hine gylde.
Qui gladium prestiterit ad occidendum aliquem (homicidium), si occidatur homo, reddat terciam partem compositionis eius; qui lanceam prestiterit, dimidiam weram; qui equum prestiterit, totum reddat.
{LXXIII} Gif mon sweordes onlæne oðres esne, ⁊ he losie, gielde he hine ðriddan dæle; gif mon spere selle, healfne; gif he horses onlæne, ealne he hine gylde.

If someone lends a sword to another’s esne and he escapes, let [the lender] pay [the lord] one third [of the esne’s value]; if he gives a spear, half; if he lends a horse, he compensates [the lord] for all [the value of the esne]

If anyone lends a sword to the servant of another man, and he makes off, he [the lender] shall pay him [the owner of the servant] a third [of his value]. If he provides [the servant] with a spear, [he shall pay the owner] half [the value of the servant]. If he lends [the servant] a horse, he shall pay him [the owner] the full value [of the servant].
If anyone lends a sword to another's servant, and he runs away, he is to pay for him a third; if he gives him a spear, half; if he lends him a horse, he is to pay his full value.

Wenn jemand dem Lohnknecht eines anderen ein Schwert leiht, und der [Knecht] entflieht, so zahle er ihn [dem Herrn] zu einem Drittel; wenn jemand eine Lanze giebt, (zahle er ihn) halb; wenn er ein Pferd darleiht, zahle er ihn ganz.

If someone lends a sword to another’s hired servant, and the [servant] runs away, let him pay for him [to the master] to the extent of a third; if someone gives a spear, (let him pay for him) half; if he lends a horse, let him pay for him in full.
div.note: esne, usually an unfree servant, see p. 393, n. 8
